title: Cluster 01 DRILL: Photosynthesis
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 5 · 10 questions · 100 marks · 35 parts · one mark per minute, so a little over an hour and a half · every question is an actual exam paper question
los_html:
Learning outcomes, against the questions that test them.

One primary concept each, checked for duplicated required answers and not merely for duplicated labels. Q1 reading a compartment off a real micrograph · Q2 the two spectra and what the gap between them proves · Q3 the light-dependent stage applied to an unfamiliar inhibitor · Q4 the whole of photophosphorylation, end to end, plus what it is for · Q5 how the proton gradient is built, and what happens when the membrane stops holding it · Q6 which Calvin intermediate moves which way, and why · Q7 rubisco as an enzyme rather than as a step in a cycle · Q8 which factor is limiting where, and what a plateau proves · Q9 chloroplast structure argued as efficiency · Q10 three different ways of breaking the same pathway. Two shared marking points exist in the set and both are deliberate. Q4 is the synthesis question, so its list reaches across Q3 and Q5 by design. Q1(c) and Q9 both credit thylakoid folding for surface area, and nothing else on the Q9 list appears anywhere in the set.

Nothing from Books 6 to 9, and nothing from Clusters 2 or 3. Glycolysis, the link reaction, the Krebs cycle, oxidative phosphorylation and the mitochondrion are Cluster 2. Respirometers, hydrogencarbonate indicator, compensation point, chromatography, DCPIP method design and results-table layout are Cluster 3. 9477 Specimen Paper 2 Question 5(c), the mean-rate calculation off Figure 5.1, has been moved to the Cluster 3 drill because it is a data-handling item and Cluster 3 is where data handling is tested.
